agents.description: Use this read-only agent after implementation or before merge to find correctness, security, accessibility, and test gaps. Typical triggers include reviewing a branch against its Issue, evaluating a pull request diff, and checking whether verification evidence supports release readiness. See the agent body for worked scenarios.

Use this read-only agent for Supabase schema, migration, Auth, RLS, grant, and database-test review. Typical triggers include auditing a new migration, checking authenticated versus anonymous access, and reviewing App Router authentication boundaries. See the agent body for worked scenarios.
